title: How to Calculate a Tip Without a Calculator
description: The find-10%-then-double shortcut for calculating a 20% tip fast, in your head.
narration_lines: Calculating a tip fast, without a calculator.
First find 10% by moving the decimal point. 10% of 45 dollars is 4 dollars 50.
For a 20% tip, just double that.
4 fifty times 2 is 9 dollars. That's your 20% tip.

params.footnote: 10% then double is the fastest way to tip
